{{Quote|The Republic calls me Iceheart, for I never show mercy.|Carac|<ref name="Score" />}}
'''Carac''', also known as "'''Iceheart Carac'''", was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. His nickname was given to him by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in light of his merciless methods and attitude. Around [[3640 BBY]] he became an officer of the [[Voidwolf's personal strike fleet]] and later volunteered himself to command it. After the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] got killed by a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], Iceheart Carac pledged himself to the newly proclaimed [[Voidhound]].<ref name="Score" />
